06c5ca64-c39c-40fa-8671-bfb593ffae0e.title: Upstream crosslink observation: issue show --json 'subissues' is never populated
06c5ca64-c39c-40fa-8671-bfb593ffae0e.description:
For operator relay to the crosslink project.

Observation: 'crosslink issue show <id> --json' returns 'subissues: []' for every issue checked, even for issues that provably have children — e.g. #745 has children #752/#753/#754 (each carries 'parent_id': 745), yet #745's 'subissues' is empty, and #754 (labelled 'review') also shows 'subissues': []. Parent linkage IS present and correct on the CHILD side ('parent_id'); only the parent-side 'subissues' array is unpopulated in the show JSON.

Verified: 326 issues carry a non-null 'parent_id'; 'subissues' length is 0 across every issue sampled.

Question: is the empty 'subissues' on 'issue show --json' intended (parent-side child lists not serialized), or a serialization gap? If intended, documenting it would help consumers; if a gap, populating 'subissues' from the parent_id index would let consumers walk parent->children without a full 'issue list' scan.

Impact on vsdd-cli: the finding-query join (#820, .design/finding-query-join.md) needed parent->child linkage to find a review round's findings. Because 'subissues' is empty, the walk instead uses one bulk 'issue list -s all --json' and filters on child 'parent_id' — functional, so this is not a blocker, just an efficiency/clarity note. Relates to #820.

1b83b6f1-6805-4bca-8e1f-1f32c0ff8769.author: xqjG
1b83b6f1-6805-4bca-8e1f-1f32c0ff8769.content: DRAFT, the vsdd side (three touches, one window; ratification is the operator's): (1) TIER CLAUSE, Trust boundaries or Conformance at action time: a schema or pattern pass is a shape fact about an artifact, never a truth fact about the system — truth-tier verdicts come only from evidence-consuming machinery (gates, the corroboration join, hash bindings); state semantics (transitions, write-time constraints, the derivation) never encode into schema pairs. Falsification: a semantic transition rule found encoded in a schema pair; a record treating a verify pass as gate evidence. Upstream precedent: Thermite doc-drift decision 5 (the thermite-state-architecture knowledge page). (2) STATE-VALIDATION RE-HOME, Conformance at action time + the phase-state resolution's executor lines: mdatron's scope is the markdown artifact estate (the operator's 2026-07-22 scope ruling: Schematron for Markdown with rust-like errors for agent-first workflows); the state artifact is YAML, so its shape validation is vsdd's own at read and write (consuming mdatron-core's engine as a library — engine reuse, not scope creep), and the state-consistency family's evidence joins (state versus gate records, tracker, git) are vsdd integrity machinery (Layer 2's snapshot-scoped checks and the gates), not an mdatron family; mdatron's Layer 7 integration narrows to the markdown-side families: routes, pins, vocabulary and register, cross-file patterns. (3) PROSE-RESTATEMENT RULE, the artifact-authoring conduct (data-side companion in the registry prose): governed-artifact prose never restates counts or enumerations the frontmatter carries — cite the field, do not copy the value (the #684/#685 drift class; Thermite prevents it by generating views; our correction is authorial until a numeric-claims pattern exists). Drafts land in the tree at the window; the window rides Layer 2's amend-then-act path with the queued items.

Design consequence — a PORTABILITY GRADIENT inversely correlated with the enforcement-grade ladder: grades 1-3 (convention/git-friction/CI-backed-block) are substrate-AGNOSTIC (git+CI+crosslink are universal); grade 4 (harness-level capability restriction, e.g. Claude Code sub-agent tool-restriction / dispatch withholding) is substrate-SPECIFIC. So the STRONGEST enforcement is the LEAST portable. Architectural discipline this implies (fold into the post-verify revision, NOT a new build now — one harness today, abstracting for a second is premature): keep the vsdd CORE (integrity queries, gates over git/CI, tracker integration, pure derivation) harness-agnostic; concentrate substrate-specifics (statusline wiring, hooks, dispatch/capability) behind the per-harness adapter the supplements+vehicle concept already provides (supplements/claude-code-cli.md today; a copilot supplement later). Mark the draft's seam family accordingly: git+CI = portable; chassis session-start/pre-tool hooks + dispatch = adapter-provided. The core/adapter boundary is hard-to-undo, so getting it harness-agnostic now is cheap; retrofitting later is expensive. Reinforces the deflate+CI decision: CI (grade 3) is the portable strong backbone; grade-4 degrades to grade-3 on a harness that lacks the primitive.

CONSOLIDATED FEEDBACK to mdatron (v0.3.0 prioritization CROSS-INFORMED by the #49 cold-read — the cold-read produced live evidence that updates our ranking, so this supersedes the two prior comments as the coherent relay):

WHAT THE COLD-READ CHANGES IN OUR PRIORITIZATION:
- B (contract-stability + audit hardening) — STILL FIRST, now with LIVE EVIDENCE, not just design-preference. The cold-read caught the shipped binary VIOLATING the documented output-marking discipline: the adopter field name rides INLINE in the engine note ('= note: Additional properties are not allowed (\'extra\' was unexpected) ()' — raw jsonschema string + trailing '()'), with no prefix-marked '= unexpected:' block (README l.83-86 promises one). That is exactly what B's envelope schema + the 'verify --compact adopter-content-prefix-marked' surface exist to fix. And it matters doubly for us: our agent-first-controls design reads mdatron output as a TRACE (the conformance leg of the mechanism-invocation-timing audit); adopter content bleeding into engine lines is a trace-integrity problem — we can't cleanly separate engine signal from adopter text. So: B first, and the output-envelope/marking hardening is the specific sub-item, evidenced.
- config.yaml documentation is a PREREQUISITE, not a nit. The cold-read could not scope jurisdiction because config.yaml's format is shown NOWHERE in README or dsl-reference. This blocks (a) any cold adopter and (b) OUR #764 migration — the v0.2.0 breaking change requires us to author a config.yaml, and we can't author to an undocumented format. Please document config.yaml (fields + an example) as part of / ahead of the jurisdiction (A) and B work.
- Install-from-v0.2.x prominence (docs + UX). bd3caf39-2e92-4cdc-95bd-f322ae2292a5.content:
vsdd-cli PRACTICE ADOPTION for mdatron's own development (operator direction 2026-07-28). Adopt the vsdd METHODOLOGY practices, not the vsdd TOOL (not at alpha; its enforcement is live-dormant). KEY INSIGHT: mdatron does not need the vsdd-cli tool to ENFORCE these practices — mdatron IS a conformance engine, so it can enforce the vsdd record-conventions on its own development using mdatron itself plus git hooks. LOAD-BEARING LESSON from this session's Red Team: practices as CONDUCT ALONE drift — deviation is cheaper than compliance and the human becomes the only gate (how every escape in our corpus happened, mine included). So adopt the practices AND bind the enforceable ones to a forcing seam.

PRACTICES (conduct): (1) phase discipline — 1a spec-review-loop, 1b verification-architecture, 1c decomposition, 2a red-gate, 2b implement-to-green, 2c exit-gate, 3 adversarial cold review, 4 ROUTE findings, 5 harden, 6 exit; layers/phases are crosslink milestones, exits are boundary commits + typed result comments. (2) ROUTE FINDINGS BEFORE FIXING (the #1 lesson) — every finding routes to the phase that would have prevented it before any fix; a fix-close with no prior routing plan is malformed; never grind fix-in-place. (3) owned/reviewed spec changes — never hand-edit the governing DESIGN solo; a spec change re-enters 1a under a declared composition + cold multi-lens review; operator ratification is the EXIT, not a substitute for the process. (4) crosslink discipline — issue-before-code; typed comments; findings carry owner+validator; closures carry evidence or a disposition. (5) naming/register — no coined labels, letter-clusters, or all-caps tokens; plain names; a durable term is a registration act.

ENFORCEMENT (mechanize with what mdatron already has — conduct alone drifts): use mdatron's own engine (rules/patterns over the design + tracker record estate) + the git pre-commit + a session-stop hook to make the key disciplines non-optional, so deviation produces compiler-shaped feedback at the act, not a latent record — e.g. an mdatron rule flagging a round-result comment missing its child-issue handle citations (parity); a pre-commit refusing a governed-DESIGN change whose commit evidence section does not cite the ratified review (amendment discipline); a check that a fix-close finding carries a prior routing plan. Bind, do not just document.

HONEST BOUNDARY: the parts that need the vsdd-cli tool — the phase-answer derivation, the process-integrity status queries, the mechanized gate commands — are not shippable yet; keep those as conduct + cold review until vsdd-cli ships; do not wait on the tool for the rest.

REUSE OUR ESCAPE CORPUS as mdatron's regression seeds: detection-without-a-seam is advisory; fix-in-place; relabel a fix-close as a disposition to dodge routing; fix with no owning finding filed before the commit; forge a self-authored gate/composition record; edit the checker itself. If mdatron's seams do not catch each, they are insufficient.

RELAY CAVEATS: (1) mdatron likely already does some of this (ran cold reviews for us, has a tracker) — this is aligning + mechanizing, not replacing; (2) the vsdd phase primers and domain prompts are deployable artifacts if mdatron wants to load them directly rather than paraphrase.

289ac202-b0a2-4108-aeaa-8dfaa6921330.content: CONTRACT-NAMED UPSTREAM CAPABILITY REQUIREMENT (the injection seam). vsdd's conformance architecture is injection-by-construction: the phase primer, composed domain personas, and supplements must be INJECTED into the dispatched agent's prompt (availability-is-not-activation; the cargo-cult founding incident). When kickoff/swarm dispatches, CROSSLINK assembles the agent prompt (KICKOFF.md protocol + rules injection) and exposes no hook for a consuming tool to add content — the contract records that the dispatch primitive 'carries none of the vsdd layer' and names kickoff prompt-assembly as the candidate seam. ASK: an injection point (flag/file/extension, e.g. --inject-context <file>) on kickoff run/plan and swarm, woven into the generated prompt. This gates vsdd riding kickoff/swarm at all — the #845 remediation's critical path. Until it exists the only conformant dispatch path is the runtime-harness Agent/Workflow fallback (the calcified deviation #845 remediates).

This IS a workable seam for the vsdd layer: the orchestrator controls the template file and can regenerate it per dispatch with the composition+primer+personas baked in. THREE CAVEATS narrow the remaining ask: (1) REPLACE, not INJECT — the custom path loses crosslink's own built prompt entirely (15-step protocol, issue id, branch, design-doc content, conventions, verify-level steps; no placeholder interpolation), so vsdd must re-author the crosslink half too and it drifts as upstream evolves; ask remains: an append/injection mode or placeholder interpolation so crosslink's half stays tool-maintained. (2) Config-level, not dispatch-level — one template path in hook-config.json races under parallel dispatches with different compositions; ask: a per-dispatch --template flag on kickoff run/plan. (3) Nothing for swarm — the template hook is kickoff-run only. Same commit also adds 'agent.binary' (swap claude for another CLI; non-claude gets prompt via stdin, Anthropic env/credential mounts gated). NOT addressed by this commit: #852 (no effort/thinking-budget flag), #837/#846/#847/#848/#849/#850 untouched. Our local mirror (6b4f736f, 2026-07-31) predates this — re-audit after next pull.

13db2503-f2d3-4846-b3f9-2aa0c4dc16c6.author: xqjG
13db2503-f2d3-4846-b3f9-2aa0c4dc16c6.content: LAYER 1 CRATE-LEVEL MODULE MAP (the layer's phase-2a design act; attended, this session). Home: vsdd-core, beside the existing schema-bundle modules. NEW MODULES: (1) diagnostics.rs — the rustc-shaped Diagnostic both new modules emit: file, failure kind, location when the failure is a parse, message, recovery action (machine token) and recovery text (human) — kinds and recovery members LOADED from the statusline data set at runtime, never hardcoded, because the kind-to-action mapping is versioned data. (2) state/ — mod.rs public API (State, read_state -> Result<State, Diagnostic>, write_state with boundary evidence); schema.rs the State struct mirroring state-schema.md's state_fields verbatim (schema_version, nullable current_phase and current_layer with the pinned null meanings, open_findings_pointer, optional last_gate_result with the closed gate-kind enum, active_composition with config_inputs_hash, optional forward-only published); read.rs effectful read wrapping a PURE validate-bytes core — bootstrap self-validation gates on schema_version before further reads; the three read-failure kinds map exactly to statusline-data's enumeration, diagnostic-never-panic on every path; write.rs atomic write (temp-plus-rename, no partial file survives) with the PURE published-immutability check (a diff touching published after first write is refused) and the declared constraints re-checked at write. (3) registry/ — mod.rs load_all yielding the nine typed sets keyed by schema_class, each validated against its .mdatron/schemas pair at read via mdatron-core (the boundary: vsdd supplies schemas, mdatron executes; self-validation until the state-consistency family lands); frontmatter.rs PURE markdown-with-frontmatter extraction with parse-location capture; sets.rs one typed struct per schema_class, field names mirroring the artifacts. PURITY BOUNDARIES per the verification architecture: parse, validate, and the immutability check are pure over bytes and values — the property and mutation targets; file IO is effectful shell, integration-tested. TRUST BOUNDARY: state.yaml and the registry are adopter-edited — every read failure yields the diagnostic, never a panic. TEST SURFACE the red gate authors against: state read (happy, absent, malformed-with-location, permission-denied, future-schema-version refused, pinned null semantics), state write (atomicity under injected failure, published immutability, evidence required), registry (all nine load from the live tree; corrupted frontmatter diagnostic; class mismatch diagnostic), diagnostics (machine form carries the loaded tokens; human form rustc-shaped; every failure path returns).

4105ef8e-c93d-49cf-a0eb-d606d6e3f3bd.content:
CAPTURE incorporating a 6-domain analysis (AI Engineer, Red Team, Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, Documentation Reviewer, Platform Engineer), each grounded in its vsdd domain prompt + live v0.3.0 output. Discovered dogfooding the mdatron v0.3.0 flip (#816). Full analysis: scratchpad/mdatron-diagnostic-efficacy-analysis.md (this session).

THEME: mdatron cannot tell 'checked N files, all clean' from 'checked nothing', and several ordinary conditions collapse a real problem into a green result. The enforcement spine we're building rests on that guardrail and inherits the blind spots.

META-HARNESS FINDINGS (ours):
- M1 conformance-clean != test-green: the pre-commit/CI gate is 'mdatron verify' ONLY; it never runs the toolkit's own tests, and nothing treated swapping the conformance engine (the v0.3.0 flip) as high-blast-radius. The flip landed as a clean boundary commit while the test suite was red; I compounded it by asserting 'clean' on partial verification (the false-assurance class #818 targets). The harness caught its builder committing the sin the harness exists to prevent.
- M2 'mdatron verify: clean' is NOT self-evidently non-vacuous: files_checked counts files-WITH-FINDINGS (verified: clean repo -> 0, identical to empty jurisdiction). No envelope field proves coverage.
- M3 the terminology / no-coined-labels register is DORMANT: config sets vocabulary_globs but families.vocabulary=inactive -> that load-bearing guardrail is not running and nothing said so.
- M4 self-audit bypass: an agent can shrink config.yaml file_globs / use --files to escape the corpus it is judged against -- sanctioned (E0060 says jurisdiction edits 'do not drift') and undetected. A self-hosted meta-harness can't detect an agent shrinking its own jurisdiction.
- M5 harness silent-tests pass VACUOUSLY: e0207_silent_* assert a code is ABSENT; an empty findings array satisfies that whether the check ran clean OR never ran. TempProject::run() reads only findings[].code, never pipeline_status.
- M6 CI stale + fail-open: mdatron-verify.yml/mdatron-test.yml reference pre-collapse mdatron-cli/mdatron-core, float to mdatron main (skew vs pinned 0.3.x local); pre-commit version guard warns-then-proceeds.

INIT QUESTION (operator asked): init PREVENTS+RESOLVES the flip trigger and our fix eac65898 applies it correctly (seeds schemas/patterns THEN inits, so schemas aren't empty -- avoiding the Red Team dissent's 'fresh-init clean over nothing' trap). BUT init is scaffolding, not armor -- the fix is CORRECT-BUT-INCOMPLETE: the silent tests still pass vacuously; the naive control 'files_checked > 0' does NOT work (M2). Durable prevention is a coverage assertion (F1), not init.

FOLLOW-ONS: F1 add positive controls to silent tests (assert pipeline_status==ok AND families.<family>==active, or a sentinel; make TempProject::run assert pipeline_status) -- completes eac65898/closes M5. F2 investigate M3 (why vocabulary inactive). F3 spine gate runs cargo test + treats guardrail-swap as full-re-verify (M1). F4 CI re-pin to a released mdatron binary + fail-closed version guard (M6). F5 standing non-vacuity proof for verify-clean (M2; depends on mdatron adding files_walked). F6 relay the mdatron diagnostic feedback (operator-mediated; 10 substantive items in the analysis Part 2).

Not fixing here (route-before-fix): this is the capture. Follow-ons to be scheduled against the enforcement-spine work.

82c3ebe9-e2f3-4cc5-a7c7-4c22e06691fe.content:
F2 ARM ATTEMPT (E0091, the flagship letter-cluster prohibition): PROVEN — authoring .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml with label_schemes.allow=[VSDD codes, MDATRON codes] flips families.vocabulary to ACTIVE and E0091 fires. But it immediately surfaced an 80-instance / 12-scheme COINAGE DEBT in the governance docs (DESIGN-METHODOLOGY.md, DESIGN-SCHEMA.md, DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md), so the armed register cannot LAND (pre-commit mdatron verify would block every commit) until triaged. Schemes:
- Allow (legit tech / false positive): SHA-# (SHA-256), OSC-# (OSC-8 terminal escape), A-Z# (regex char-class fragment).
- Bare code refs (governance call: allow bare, or require VSDD-/MDATRON- prefix): E# x14 (E0099...), W# x7 (W0191...), L# x1 (L0050).
- ID schemes needing operator adjudication (register the scheme in allow, OR rewrite as coinage): F# x25 (the canonical prohibited finding-mode coinage), R# x19 (requirement IDs?), MITIG-F# x4 (mitigation IDs?), M# x3, STEP-# x3, SO-F# x1.
BLOCKERS TO LANDING: (1) per-scheme registration decisions are operator-owned (no self-served schemes); (2) rewriting the real coinages is in the DESIGN contract -> spec amendment at scale (owned + reviewed, spec-review loop), not a solo sweep. Held .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml out of the tree pending adjudication; re-applies in seconds once the allow-list + rewrite scope are decided. The arming mechanism itself (F2's goal) is confirmed working.

91590096-b17a-4f94-86c3-44d8d84c75a0.author: xqjG
91590096-b17a-4f94-86c3-44d8d84c75a0.content:
F2 DONE (investigation of M3 — the dormant terminology guardrail). CONCLUSION: the 'no coined labels'/terminology-grounding discipline is NOT mechanized on this tree; it is convention-grade only.
- families.vocabulary=inactive because .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml (mdatron's E0090 register) is ABSENT. We half-wired it: vocabulary_globs IS set in .mdatron/config.yaml (methodology.md, DESIGN-*.md), but with no register the family never activates. The half-wiring is misleading — it implies vocabulary enforcement that does not run.
- MDATRON-E0090 = 'unregistered-coinage' (introduced v0.2.0): fires when a bold-introduced term in governed prose is absent from .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml. This IS the mechanized form of the coinage discipline.
- The vsdd-NATIVE enforcer referenced by templates/registry/vocabulary.yaml + methodology docs — check-naming-discipline.py (VSDD-W0001) — does NOT exist in the tree and is wired nowhere (0 refs in .githooks/.github/.crosslink; pre-commit runs only mdatron verify). So the vsdd-native mechanization is spec'd-but-unbuilt.
- templates/registry/vocabulary.yaml exists (~70 terms, schema_class vocabulary-registry, deployed to .vsdd/registry/ by vsdd init) — data with no running consumer.
DECISION NEEDED (terminology register is operator-owned spec work — not solo-armable; arming fires a triage-needing E0090 set over methodology.md + DESIGN-*.md): (a) ARM mdatron E0090 — author .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml (port/adapt from templates/registry/vocabulary.yaml; note path+schema differ), then triage; moves the discipline convention->CI-grade; OR (b) REMOVE the misleading vocabulary_globs half-wiring until a register is authored. Either way, stop implying enforcement that isn't running. This is a concrete instance of the enforcement-grade ladder: a load-bearing discipline sitting at convention grade with an available CI-grade mechanization unadopted.

3ea9d803-7cb9-4ed6-93db-3c490fc2a70d.author: xqjG
3ea9d803-7cb9-4ed6-93db-3c490fc2a70d.content: OperatorDirectiveApplied{directive: consent-posture-container-vehicle} — SO RULING 2026-08-02. THE RULING: vsdd's autonomous dispatch vehicle is CONTAINER-BASED crosslink kickoff (kickoff run --container), which is non-interactive (docker run -d = no TTY = the folder-trust dialog cannot render). Gate-disabling (--skip-permissions / --dangerously-skip-permissions) is NOT ADOPTED — the container's non-interactivity IS the mechanism, not disabling approval gates. This is the pure approve-then-dispatch model: the operator's dispatch act is the consent; the container has no interactive gate to bypass. RETIRES the open question 'may headless dispatch run gate-disabled?' with a definitive NO. Grounded in dollspace-gay/crosslink#55's refined diagnosis (container path verified working headless end-to-end; tmux/plan path structurally blocked by TTY-gated folder-trust). ACTIONABILITY: the container vehicle is stand-up-able — image ghcr.io/dollspace-gay/crosslink-agent (our mirror's default, container.rs:43) with a local 'just build-image' fallback (the :local convention); forecast-bio/crosslink#576 image-publish CLOSED-completed ('should be good now'), dollspace-gay publication to confirm at Phase-5 build time. DOWNSTREAM EDITS ROUTED (deferred past the feat/820 merge to avoid branch churn; execute when the branch state is clean): (1) AFFORDANCE MAP — flip the autonomous-execution binding from container-BLOCKED/attended-tmux-working-posture to container-ADOPTED; tmux/local declined (interactive, stalls headless); gate-disabling explicitly not the mechanism (map recorded-pair discipline, DE lens). (2) DEVIATION REGISTRY — entry 5 (container-kickoff-blocked-posture): re-scope its trigger from '#9/#10 closed' to 'container image usable' (#9/#10 done via PR #64; the residual is image availability); entry 1 (manual-dispatch-fallback): trigger_context names the container vehicle as the adopted exit once the dispatch integration is built (Phase 5/6) + image usable — stays standing (integration unbuilt). Both SO re-arms under this disposition. (3) CONTRACT — the dispatch-posture language (attended/autonomous; the affordance map member's autonomous-execution binding) FOLDS INTO THE UNIFICATION cycle per the prior triage ruling (no separate amendment). (4) PHASE 5 1b — the dispatch design targets the container vehicle (kickoff run --container + the swarm equivalent), non-interactive, no gate-disabling; pairs with the reviewer-roles-as-agent-types adoption. (5) UPSTREAM — support dollspace-gay/crosslink#55's recommended fix (make kickoff plan non-interactive OR add --container to plan) since the PLAN path (gap analysis) stays tmux-blocked; note on #55.

503becf2-c3b7-45f2-a412-192fd8a1828f.title: Consolidate parallel design tree: fold mdatron methodology-process docs back into vsdd-cli + crosslink
503becf2-c3b7-45f2-a412-192fd8a1828f.description:
Current state: 

Desired state: 

Reason: 

## What

I authored a parallel methodology-process layer in the mdatron repo (BOUNDARY-PREAMBLE, V1-SHIP-CRITERIA, BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION, STEP-2-SCOPE, dsl-falsifiability-report, .vsdd/events/, "Step 0.5 / Step 1 / Step 2" framing) that is parallel to vsdd-cli's own design tree. Operator diagnosed it correctly: the workstream should have been driven by VSDD's phase primers + crosslink's issue/knowledge substrate; instead I created an invented coordination layer that is now creating confusion.

## Why this is tracked rather than fixed now

Per operator directive 2026-06-01: "Mark as cleanup; continue current work; revisit after Phase A.1 lands." mdatron's Phase A.1 foundational work (JSON Schema dispatch, DSL parser, cross-file index, etc.) is the priority; consolidation cleanup follows.

## What the cleanup entails

When this issue activates:

1. DESIGN-MDATRON.md: relocate to vsdd-cli/ as a sibling DESIGN doc alongside DESIGN-SCHEMA.md, DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md, etc. OR keep in mdatron as a subsystem-internal spec — operator decides.
2. BOUNDARY-PREAMBLE.md: 8 declarations scattered to where they logically belong in vsdd-cli's existing docs (substrate composition, binary surface, cross-doc graph, artifact class split, install order — most already mirrored at Step 0.5).
3. V1-SHIP-CRITERIA.md: fold into vsdd-cli/DESIGN-METHODOLOGY OR file as a crosslink milestone for v1.0 ship.
4. BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION.md: the generic bootstrap-period methodology pattern belongs in vsdd-cli/DESIGN-METHODOLOGY as a sanctioned discipline. Specific mitigations either retire or become crosslink issues.
5. STEP-2-SCOPE.md: retire as a scratchpad. Remaining work items become crosslink issues.
6. .vsdd/events/*.yaml on both repos: replaced by crosslink session events when event-emission tooling lands. Until then, composition declarations go in commit messages per BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION § Mitigation 3 literal reading.
7. mdatron repo final shape: Cargo workspace + README pointing to vsdd-cli for canonical design + CHANGELOG + LICENSE. No methodology-process docs of its own.

## Going forward (process)

- crosslink issues drive trackable work
- crosslink knowledge pages hold canonical content (per the existing vsdd-cli pattern)
- vsdd-cli's existing DESIGN docs absorb mdatron-related content where appropriate
- mdatron repo stays minimal: Rust code + thin README

## Acceptance criteria

- mdatron repo contains only: Cargo.toml, mdatron-core/, mdatron-cli/, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, target/ (gitignored)
- vsdd-cli design docs absorb the load-bearing content from the deleted mdatron process docs
- Going-forward work tracked via crosslink issues, not standalone markdown scope artifacts

## Trigger

Revisit after mdatron Phase A.1 (foundational engine: JSON Schema dispatch, DSL parser, cross-file index, error catalog loader, 5 built-in patterns) is sufficiently mature that the parallel-design-tree pollution becomes the bottleneck.

SYMPTOM (crosslink @ develop / 0.9.0-beta, macOS): 'crosslink kickoff plan <design-doc>' launches a read-only plan-analysis agent successfully — worktree created, feature branch, tmux session active, trust auto-approved — but the in-agent analysis NEVER progresses. OBSERVATIONS over 15+ min each:
- 'kickoff status' stays 'running (no status file yet)', tmux 'active', indefinitely.
- 'kickoff show-plan' -> 'No gap report found yet ... still running'.
- Zero file writes in the agent's worktree (find -newermt '-3 minutes' empty).

- 'kickoff stop' only 'sent interrupt'; needed 'stop --force' to kill the tmux session; 'cleanup' needed --force to remove the stale worktrees.

HYPOTHESIS: the tmux-spawned agent isn't entering its work loop — possibly no model credentials/access in the spawned session, an unshown interactive prompt (e.g. a permission/trust gate the agent is blocked on), or a silent startup failure. The launch path works; the agent runtime inside doesn't.

a534d9bf-89a0-450d-8742-344b26da7d6b.author: xqjG
a534d9bf-89a0-450d-8742-344b26da7d6b.content:
AMENDMENT DRAFT — awaiting operator ratification (I draft, you ratify; on your word it binds, I apply the contract text + Revision line, run the minimal rebuild, one verify round, and close Layer 3). Routed here from the Layer-3 terminal-safety finding class (#788/#793/#798/#803/#804 and siblings) per the #806 phase-4 pass.

PROPOSED ADDITION to the Status requirement (contract ~line 173), a new paragraph:

  'Terminal-output safety: every string vsdd renders to a terminal or
   agent-consumed surface — the segment, the human form, the machine
   form, and the broken-state outputs — that is sourced from outside the
   tool's own trusted constants (adopter-edited state, tracker and git
   query output, adopter-authored registry data) is stripped of the
   display-unsafe Unicode class before it reaches that surface. The class
   is defined by Unicode property, never a hand-enumerated list: the
   control category, the format category, the line and paragraph
   separators, and every code point carrying Default_Ignorable_Code_Point
   — including the property's reserved (unassigned) half, which renders
   invisibly on conformant terminals. Combining marks and normal spaces
   are preserved: they are legitimate text in the world's scripts, not
   the hidden-Unicode threat. Cleaning happens at the source boundaries —
   the acquisition, the state read, and the registry load — so every
   downstream rendering inherits safe data; the machine form, whose
   serialization can carry any struct field, is additionally sanitized
   whole at output so no field can be missed. The threat is
   display-spoofing and invisible smuggling into agent context (the
   Trojan-Source class; the same hidden-Unicode threat crosslink names for
   inbound web content), and the requirement is the outbound peer of
   that inbound rule.'

PLUS a Trust-boundaries / boundary-procedure note (raise, do not block):

  'Terminal-output safety is a candidate shared primitive: crosslink's
   safe-fetch already sanitizes inbound content and its rules name the
   hidden-Unicode threat, so a single shared implementation could serve
   both the inbound (strip what you read) and outbound (strip what you
   emit) directions rather than each tool re-deriving it. vsdd satisfies
   the requirement locally now via the UCD property; the shared-primitive
   question is raised to crosslink under the three-question boundary
   procedure (vsdd-cli #739) as a separate, non-blocking item.'

MECHANISM (verification-architecture note, 1b): the implementation uses the Default_Ignorable_Code_Point property from a maintained UCD crate (verify exact crate/API at implementation — unicode-properties is the candidate), REPLACING the hand-rolled category+range+Hangul-enumeration classifier. The enumeration approach is explicitly rejected: rounds 3-6 demonstrated it is always one adversarial probe short of the class. The existing rounds-1-to-5 tests become this requirement's verification architecture; the round-6 uncommitted edits are superseded (keep the recursive JSON sanitizer, discard the Hangul enumeration).

SCOPE: the init/preflight command surface (the Layer 4 carry, #796) falls under this same requirement when Layer 4 hardens; the cleaner is the shared one.

ON RATIFICATION, in order: apply the clause + Revision line (mdatron verify); swap the predicate to the UCD property and keep the machine-form recursive sanitizer (drop the uncommitted Hangul arm); re-point the existing terminal-safety tests as the requirement's verification; one verify round against the specified requirement; close #803/#804/#805 as resolved-by-amendment; close Layer 3 to its boundary. RATIFICATION ASK: approve the two clauses as drafted, or redline.

078dd7ad-a3be-49de-b680-10fda4958d8b.author: xqjG
078dd7ad-a3be-49de-b680-10fda4958d8b.content: THIRD MDATRON RAISE (operator-caught 2026-07-22, correcting the crosslink strict-YAML item's routing): the design.md defect ALSO goes to mdatron, and it is the more structural of the two. The crosslink side (ship valid YAML) fixes one file; the mdatron side fixes the class. RAISE 3 — SCOPING / IGNORE LIST: mdatron walks every frontmatter-bearing markdown in the tree, including files it neither owns nor should govern — chassis-deployed command files, third-party artifacts. A malformed third-party file therefore blocks the CONSUMER's commits over a document mdatron has no mandate to validate. Passes the three-question gate: in scope (which markdown mdatron validates is core Schematron-for-markdown territory), unsupported today (it walks all), generic (any consumer with third-party-deployed markdown wants it). Asks: a route-table-style ALLOWLIST (mdatron validates only what a consumer explicitly routes — Thermite's spec-routes.toml is the precedent, and the estate's own contract already carries a closed-world route table as a first-class concept) OR an IGNORE LIST as the lighter interim; plus a stated default (walk-all vs route-only) — the route-only default is the closed-world-correct one. This retires the design.md incident's whole class: with routing, an unrouted chassis command file is simply not mdatron's to refuse. The crosslink filing stays drafted (ship valid YAML regardless); the mdatron raise is the durable fix. Relay text for carriage delivered in-session alongside raises 1 and 2.

315086f8-e316-45af-b69e-e137015e9644.content:
THE DEVIATION (recorded; the record stands per the ungated-work discipline).

WHAT: contract amendments #806 (routing format-carry + invariant-first principle) and #807 (terminal-output-safety requirement + shared-primitive boundary raise) were authored and committed directly to the ratified governing document (.design/agent-first-vsdd-toolkit.md) by a single agent inside a Layer-3 EXECUTION session, on operator content-approval alone.

WHY IT IS A DEVIATION — two ways, one root:
1. VSDD process: a spec amendment is a re-entry into phase 1a/1b — authored under a declared composition, run through cold review lenses, THEN ratified. Operator approval is the phase EXIT (the ratification gate), never a substitute for the phase's composition and review. The amendment was inlined into execution with neither; the earlier amendments (#730, #739) were legitimate precisely because they ran under the phase-1c spec-review loop with rounds and dispositions.
2. Domain ownership (operator guidance): spec-contract changes are the Solution Owner's to author; the prose and register are Documentation Reviewer / Technical Writer's. A solo agent editing the contract's normative text and register bypassed all three owning domains.

ROOT: this is the same collapse the whole session has been catching — an owned, reviewed process skipped in favor of solo-act-on-approval. #806 was findings orphaned by skipping phase 4; this is an amendment orphaned by skipping phase 1a/1b. Third occurrence of the pattern this session.

REMEDIATION (operator-directed, path A): reverted in commit 9b451099 (contract restored to 25851ca0; mdatron clean). The drafted text is preserved on #806/#807 and re-enters phase 1a/1b as the DRAFT — no drafting lost, but it now gets the composition and cold review it skipped, with operator ratification as the true exit. #806 and #807 reopened for that re-entry. The deviation record stands regardless of the redo.

0ef85e9b-af3c-4436-bef1-2370bbb3b5df.content:
RED TEAM ESCAPE ANALYSIS (design v2, 2 adversaries, Opus 4.8) — BOTH return golden_path_verdict = NOT-THE-EASY-PATH. This challenges the design core, correctly.
MASTER FINDING: every now-built v2 control is detection-only, non-blocking, surfaced through a vsdd status poll — while ALL real enforcement seams (Layer-4 install/hooks, Layer-6 gates, Layer-7 conformance, #816 mdatron) are downstream/unbuilt. During the bootstrap window v2 targets, it REBUILDS THE EXACT CORPUS TOPOLOGY: a record a human must read, caught by the operator, never by a control. The six-round collapse re-runs identically. And the incentive gradient still favors deviation: for every flagship escape (hand-roll design, fix-in-place, phase-compress) the deviation stays cheaper than compliance because nothing FORCES the compliant path; bootstrap format-carries are conventions the contract itself says fail because they depend on the agent choosing to comply.
BLOCKING ESCAPES: (1) detection-only = advisory, not enforcement, in bootstrap [both]; (2) the keystone audits every OTHER mechanism but nothing audits whether the AUDIT ran — it is exempt from its own discipline (absence of a poll leaves no trace) [A]; (3) the incentive gradient points away from compliance [B]; (4) the "non-bypassable Layer-6 backstop" is a commit-time gate skippable via --no-verify (true non-bypassability needs server-side CI) [A].
SUBSTANTIVE ESCAPES: disposition-closure exemption = universal routing bypass (relabel fix-closes as consolidated/dismissed); fix-with-no-owning-finding is invisible to routing detection (the June narration pattern); state.yaml composition is agent-authored so "tamper-evident" is a category error (git proves authorship not truth); routing edge checked for PRESENCE not correctness (attach to any target); pin --update re-pin passes the drift gate without re-review; phase-transition gate reads self-authored records; SELF-MODIFICATION — the agent edits the detection scripts (managed artifacts it can also edit); an unwired instance control is a silent aggregate gap; done-conditions are self-authored 2-fixture tests.
KEY BUILDABLE-NOW FIX (Adversary A): bind the now-built detection to a FIRED seam that exists today — a session-stop hook that runs status and non-zero-exits on any new integrity finding, and/or the existing git pre-commit refusing a governed-set commit while an unrouted/ungated finding stands — so deviation produces compiler-shaped feedback, not a latent record. Absent that, mark the increment honestly as ADVISORY, not enforcement. This reopens dogfood decision (A): a forcing seam IS buildable now (the repo already has a pre-commit), so detection-only-without-a-seam was the wrong scoping.
Folding into v3 with the terminal-verify + the wider-eval #817 (still running).

4f575518-34ee-484d-ad0e-f6e47e07638f.content:
Thermite architecture study (agent report 2026-07-28); filed dollspace-gay/Thermite#93 for its enforcement drift. Lessons for #815 (the tamper-proof / grade-4 half):
1. Tool-allowlist-per-role IS real grade-4 — Claude Code refuses an ungranted tool (verified: acto-critic lacks Edit). BUT a capability fence is only as strong as the FULL residual set: Thermite's critic still holds Write+Bash, so its 'read-only' is grade-1 convention, not capability. A genuine read-only critic must withhold EVERY mutation tool (drop Write, constrain Bash) or run on a read-only mount. This is precisely WHY #815's tamper-evidence-by-corroboration half stays necessary — it covers the residual Write/Bash surface a porous fence cannot.
2. Add a LIVENESS axis orthogonal to the 4 grades: a designed grade is worthless if de-wired. Thermite's two edit-time gates silently died (commit 5581b65f) and every doc still claims them live. The meta-harness must ROUTE ITS OWN CONTROL PLANE (settings.json, agent defs) — a gate that guards the gates. Directly reinforces the vsdd draft's own 'route the control plane' instinct.
3. Split grade 2: 2a commit/push-time (records a deviation) vs 2b edit-time PreToolUse (prevents the edit) — 2b is closer to grade-4 in effect and still substrate-portable; a sweet spot for controls that can't be grade-4.
4. Match doc claims to enforced reality mechanically. Thermite's goal.md R-SIDE-1/R-BV-1 'forward-looking — not yet enforced' labels are the good model; make 'enforced' a checked property (a test asserting the claimed wiring exists).

2d9a5862-69d1-41ec-94da-197ce00c575a.author: xqjG
2d9a5862-69d1-41ec-94da-197ce00c575a.content:
GOAL: land .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml armed for MDATRON-E0091 (letter-cluster prohibition) — mechanizing the 'no coined labels' discipline from convention grade to CI-backed. Parent: #822 F2 (arming proven; families.vocabulary flips active; but 80-instance/12-scheme coinage debt in the DESIGN docs blocks landing since pre-commit mdatron verify would fail).

STEP 1 — adjudicate the 12 schemes (per scheme: allow a legit/registered scheme, or rewrite an ad-hoc coinage):
- ALLOW (legit tech / false positive): SHA-<n> (SHA-256), OSC-<n> (OSC-8 terminal escape), A-Z<n> (regex char-class fragment).
- BARE CODE REFS (governance call — allow bare '^[EWL][0-9]{4}$', or require VSDD-/MDATRON- prefixes): E-code refs x14 (E0099...), W-code refs x7 (W0191...), L-code ref x1 (L0050).
- ADJUDICATE (register the scheme in allow, OR rewrite as coinage): finding-mode F-number x25 (the canonical prohibited pattern), requirement R-number x19, mitigation MITIG-F-number x4, milestone/mode M-number x3, STEP-number x3, domain-finding SO-F-number x1.

STEP 2 — rewrite the adjudicated coinages in DESIGN-METHODOLOGY.md / DESIGN-SCHEMA.md / DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md via the SPEC-REVIEW LOOP (owned: composition + cold review; operator approval is the exit gate, not a substitute). Not a solo sweep.

STEP 3 — author .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml with the adjudicated label_schemes.allow; mdatron verify clean; commit (pre-commit passes). Optional further stage: arm E0090 (bold-term register) by porting templates/registry/vocabulary.yaml into the terms: schema.

LANDING CRITERIA: governed docs E0091-clean + register committed + families.vocabulary active. Note the irony worth recording: the contract that defines the no-coined-labels discipline currently violates it at scale.

8024f9be-fc74-4585-970d-68789fb87440.title: parse_milestones treats crosslink 'No milestones found.' as Unusable, not an empty list
8024f9be-fc74-4585-970d-68789fb87440.description:
Discovered during Slice-1 finding-join dogfood (#820).

vsdd-core/src/snapshot/acquire.rs parse_milestones treats crosslink's empty-state human output 'No milestones found.' as whole-format drift -> None -> AcquisitionOutcome::Unusable, instead of an empty milestone list. On any repo with no crosslink milestones (this one included), acquire_snapshot short-circuits to Unusable and never reaches the session or finding-query legs.

Repro: 'crosslink milestone list' -> 'No milestones found.'; acquire_snapshot(repo) -> Unusable.

Impact: the live status answer + the finding-query join are unreachable on no-milestone repos. Pre-existing (Layer 1/2 milestone leg); outside the Slice-1 finding-join build scope, so filed + routed rather than fixed inline.

Fix direction: parse_milestones should recognize crosslink's empty-state message as a lawful empty list (0 milestones), distinct from unparseable drift. Needs its own red-gate test (empty-message -> Some(empty), not None). Relates to #820.

Red gate observed (crosslink_empty_state_message_is_an_empty_list failed against the prior parser, green after). cargo test --workspace + clippy + mdatron all green. Awaits operator push + PR; end-to-end 'vsdd status' works once this and the #820 join are both on main.

It gives routing the same bootstrap standing parity already has, so the asymmetry that let six rounds orphan is removed. The heavy Layer-6 gate still lands where its dependencies are; this only carries the DISCIPLINE forward until then, which is precisely the pattern the contract already uses for parity.

Two operator decisions remain open on the finding, NOT folded into this draft: (1) whether to pull the tracker-only queries forward out of Layer 6 (re-sequencing); (2) whether to elevate invariant-first decomposition to a stated 1a/1b principle. On approval I add it to the contract, record the Revision-line entry, and apply the format-carry to the remainder of THIS layer's work — including the Layer-3 terminal-safety finding set, which gets its owed phase-4 routing pass under the new clause.

3c477102-2894-45c3-a074-d45540956dde.author: xqjG
3c477102-2894-45c3-a074-d45540956dde.content:
THE FINDING (discovered during Layer 3's phase-3 loop, 2026-07-27, operator-surfaced).

WHAT HAPPENED. Layer 3's phase-3 ran six rounds. Every round's findings were filed as child issues and closed with fix (result) comments; NONE carried a routing disposition naming a target phase. Phase 4 (the Feedback Integration Loop) never ran for any finding. This is the phase-4 primer's named primary failure mode verbatim — 'routing every finding to Phase 2b, which collapses the pipeline' — and a scale model of the June cycle the tool exists to prevent (137 findings, 82 orphaned, contract line 55/85). The spec (DESIGN.md Status requirement) did not change across six rounds while vsdd's code churned every round — the exact collapse signal the primer describes.

ROOT CAUSE (why it was possible). The mechanism that enforces routing — the unrouted-findings query, 'Phase 4 closes only when the unrouted-findings query returns empty' (contract line 62), tested by 'a fixture with unrouted findings fails phase-4 exit' (line 191) — ships as a Layer 6 gate (line 261). Finding-lifecycle enforcement is Layer 7 (line 262); directive classification is Layer 8 (line 263). We are at Layer 3. Nothing built enforces routing.

TWO SEPARABLE DEFECTS.
1. PACKAGING: the unrouted-findings query is a thin tracker query (does each round-child carry a plan comment naming a target phase?). It depends on crosslink typed comments — which exist today — NOT on Layer 4 install or Layer 5 composition. It was bundled into the Layer 6 'Gates' milestone by component cohesion, riding downstream on the coattails of the expensive gates (fix-scale red gate, mutation floor, fresh-container smoke) that genuinely need Layers 4-5. Cohesion-by-name, not true dependency.
2. MISSING BOOTSTRAP CARRY: the contract already anticipates late gates by giving their disciplines interim format-carry conventions during bootstrap. Parity got one (line 176: 'During bootstrap, the parity discipline is format-carried: a round result comment is malformed unless it cites its child-issue handles'). Routing — the more mission-critical of the two — got NO equivalent clause. So for Layers 1-5, phase-4 routing has neither a built gate nor a bootstrap convention; its only enforcement is the attended operator.

STRUCTURAL READING. The decomposition ordered by architectural component (core layers -> binary -> hooks/dispatch) rather than invariant-first. Consequence: the tool's raison d'etre — flow-enforcement — sits at milestone 6-of-10, so the trusted (un-self-enforced) base is Layers 0-5, the large majority of the build. A verifier cannot self-verify into existence — a trusted base is unavoidable — but this decomposition made it maximal rather than minimal. The attended-design posture is the contract's acknowledgment of the bootstrap gap, and it worked here: the operator supplied the missing gate by inspection. But that is the operator standing in for a gate, not the gate.

c6fb0362-033c-44fa-9cbb-3f1f782b38af.content:
Mechanism (three levels), motivated directly by the #19 cleanup reviews:
1. STRUCTURAL — keep the README thin on drift-prone facts; describe durable orientation + point at the authoritative source (contract for spec, vsdd --help for commands, Cargo.toml for build). Single-source-of-truth + reference-it. (Already applied in the rewrite.)
2. MECHANIZED (CI-backed block) — (a) command-surface match: the README's documented commands must match the built clap Command enum / vsdd --help (catches SO-F1-class: README overclaimed 'round-parity' as built when it's dormant, and stale command lists); (b) reference/link integrity: README + governed-corpus body links must resolve — catches DR-F1: the primer/domain-prompt body links to deleted docs that mdatron's cross-references check MISSED (it validates frontmatter slugs only, not markdown-body links — a real gap: extend the cross-ref check to body links, or add a link-checker CI leg). README re-enters light mdatron jurisdiction (it was dropped #830 as transitional prose — that status no longer holds now it's the kept README).
3. SHIFT-LEFT — bind the freshness check to the trigger: a command-surface change (main.rs clap enum) requires the README command section to update in the same PR (artifact-and-its-record-land-together, the §131/#840 pairing applied to docs).
Registers as a control per #840 (README claims = controls with a fire-proof: the claimed thing is real). Grade: convention now → CI-backed block target. NOTE the concrete CI gap this exposes: mdatron cross-references validates frontmatter slugs, not body links — that's why DR-F1's dangling primer links stayed green.

A structured close-reason field would supersede that label convention: the join's read moves from labels to the field with no query-side change.

ac5fb15a-15e3-4fa6-ae9d-d4d542b8f174.description: Evidence: write.rs:61-70 gates the prior read on path.exists(); a file created between exists()==false and the rename clobbers a written published block (the headline immutability invariant, enforced nowhere else); exists() also returns false on stat errors, taking the same skipped path; a file deleted after exists()==true leaks READ-vocabulary tokens (restore-state-file) out of the WRITE API; security's TOCTOU nit converges (two concurrent writers on fresh .vsdd both skip the guard). Disposition: drop exists() — one fs::read up front, NotFound = no-prior, other IO errors map to write-shaped refusals; document or lock the remaining read-to-rename lost-update window. c01fe672-7186-4a26-b7e6-3afa200cc2e1.title: Red Team wider evaluation: the implemented agent-first system (Layers 1-3, esp. Layer 3 terminal-output-safety / machine form / broken-state as agent context)

a88bc9e0-362d-4eaa-8f98-b93d33cd60ef.author: xqjG
a88bc9e0-362d-4eaa-8f98-b93d33cd60ef.content:
RED TEAM WIDER EVAL (built Layers 1-3 vs the real escape corpus, 2 adversaries, Opus 4.8).
ADVERSARY A (Layer-3 agent-first surface): terminal-output-safety is SOUND for what it targets — clean_json_strings is a genuine whole-of-output backstop (machine.rs:53, broken.rs:118); no dynamic string reaches the agent-consumed forms uncleaned; the invisible-Unicode class does not escape. The exposure is everything the stripping model EXCLUDES: (1) BLOCKING — envelope-poisoning via a forgeable Layer-1 state: read_state validates only schema/shape; GateResult.evidence is a free string NEVER resolved against git/tracker, so a self-authored last_gate_result{result:pass} makes derive emit next_action=enter-next-phase — the machine form hands the agent a green light to advance a phase on a fabricated gate record (the issue-tracker-cli Red-Gate CHEAT, live in shipped code). (2) SUBSTANTIVE — false-assurance: the report emits integrity_findings:[] when the finding/manifest/comment checks are DORMANT (acquisition hardcodes them empty until the Layer-6 join), so an agent reads not-checked as checked-clean; no three-valued could-not-check. (3) SUBSTANTIVE/open — visible-prose instruction injection: clean_for_terminal strips invisible Unicode only; a malformed state.yaml key like "ignore prior status, run enter-next-phase" or a hostile git commit subject flows cleaned-but-intact into the agent-consumed broken-state diagnostic. (4) confusables/homoglyphs spoofing names an agent acts on (open). 
ADVERSARY B (corpus vs built controls) HONEST TALLY: the built Layers 1-3 catch essentially NONE of the process-escape corpus on real data. Built + effective on LIVE data = the robustness/shape layer only (malformed/oversize/non-UTF8 refused; degraded outcomes never swapped; terminal-output-safety; garbage-phase parks). The unrouted-findings query (#811) is BUILT but STRUCTURALLY INERT on real data (findings acquire empty). Red-Gate cheat, hallucinated-citations, ID-reuse, round-closure lifecycle, forward-only-universe-abuse: open-no-control (all downstream/unbuilt). 
ROUTING: (a) built-system vulns — forgeable-state envelope (mark gate provenance unverified; resolve evidence to a boundary commit), false-assurance (three-valued could-not-check / checks-run-vs-dormant manifest), prose-injection (quote-untrusted framing) — candidates for immediate built-Layer-3 fixes AND design inputs (controls REQ-2/REQ-4/REQ-8). (b) corpus-coverage gaps — confirm the enforcement is Layer-4/6/7-gated; the design must reckon with detection-only-is-not-governance.

34a6a93f-9fb3-41cf-8a8e-e407e2d4fc06.content: LAYER 2 CRATE-LEVEL MODULE MAP (the design act). Home: vsdd-core beside Layer 1. NEW MODULES: (1) snapshot/ — mod.rs the Snapshot struct mirroring snapshot-schema's snapshot_fields verbatim (acquisition_outcome enum acquired|absent|unusable; milestones, findings, round_manifests, round_children, comment_handles, the four display fields); acquire.rs the EFFECTFUL acquisition building the snapshot from the chassis's query surface — one acquisition per invocation, absent and unusable outcomes never panic (the count-conduct instruments join at Layer 3). (2) answer/ — mod.rs the PhaseAnswer struct (phase, layer, next_action from the vocabulary, active composition echo, degraded kind, integrity findings at the kind-set grain); derive.rs the PURE derivation (State, Snapshot, the loaded registry data) -> PhaseAnswer — deterministic, degraded exactly when the outcome is absent or unusable with the kind never swapped, null phase mapping to the enter action, fix-lane tokens excluded from the output domain per the #689 ruling; integrity.rs the PURE snapshot-scoped checks, the audit's six less the degraded-kind check (which is the derivation's own enforced property): round-parity, unresolvable handles, findings missing owner or validator, closed findings missing evidence, phase pointer against milestone state. (3) integrity_shell/ — refs.rs the off-grammar query: a PURE membership core over injected ref names consuming the registered branch grammar (both forms plus exempt refs), the git listing in the shell; substrate.rs the session-substrate check over the installed-artifact manifest — three-valued fail-closed per entry by its resolution field, plus the project-root-equals-repo-root member. PURITY: derive, integrity, and refs membership are pure property targets; acquisition, git listing, and filesystem resolution are shell. DEPENDENCY, PE-FLAGGED: the regex crate — the branch grammar's registered patterns are regex strings in versioned data, and hand-rolling a matcher would reimplement what the data declares; investigation note follows with the suite. DATA-SHAPE PREREQUISITE, found by this design act: dispatch-data's exempt refs live in rules PROSE while this layer's refs query consumes them as data — the #688-adopted set promotes to a structured exempt_refs field under the pair rule (data-side mechanical, the adopted content unchanged), and sets.rs types branch_grammar per its Layer 2 deepening annotation. ROUND TOTAL ~$20.80 API-equivalent (under this estate's subscription auth this expresses as window consumption, not billed dollars — the attribution-grain rule — but the documented weights are the canonical ranking). STRUCTURE: cache-write (context accumulation at 1.25x) and output (25x the cache-read rate) are the expensive units; the headline multi-million cache-read numbers are the CHEAP unit (0.1x). The levers, re-ranked by documented weights: (1) context accumulated per lens (cache-write), (2) output volume incl. thinking, (3) turn count (drives cache-read AND re-writes). MODEL TIER, observed + documented: the five lenses ran claude-opus-4-8 ($5/$25); the session model (claude-fable-5) is documented at $10/$50 — exactly 2x per token. The harness already routes fan-outs to the cheaper tier; the same round on the session model would have weighed ~$41.60. Model-per-dispatch is a 2x lever and our manifest had recorded it wrong (see the #673 correction). EFFORT, documented: Claude Code defaults to xhigh on this tier; effort controls thinking depth and overall token spend (lower = fewer, more consolidated tool calls — the turn-count driver we measured); thinking bills as output tokens; the Workflow orchestration surface exposes per-agent effort (opts.effort) while the plain fan-out tool does not — so effort-controlled A/B rounds are ALREADY POSSIBLE via the workflow vehicle, a capability note for the measured-pass design.

6cfc32a9-48c8-407a-9196-4b20f2d922a1.author: xqjG
6cfc32a9-48c8-407a-9196-4b20f2d922a1.content: OBSERVED MAKEUP, round 1 (capture source: subagent transcript usage records, parsed by the bootstrap adapter script this comment describes — the transcripts carry per-request input/output/cache-read/cache-write): solution-architect 15.3k uncached-in / 1.65M cache-read / 650k cache-write / 51.4k out, 39 api turns, tools 22 Read + 2 Bash; solution-owner 15.3k / 3.75M / 402k / 41.3k, 56 turns, 15 Bash + 14 Read; documentation-reviewer 27.3k / 2.65M / 354k / 40.3k, 62 turns, 22 Bash + 11 Read; quality-engineer 19.0k / 472k / 235k / 25.0k, 22 turns, 10 Read; ux 18.5k / 1.10M / 104k / 25.9k, 47 turns, 17 Bash + 5 Read. THE OPTIMIZATION SIGNAL (the operator's tool-mix hypothesis confirmed): cache-read volume tracks API TURN COUNT, not artifact size — every tool call triggers a full-context cache re-read, so the 56-turn Bash-heavy solution-owner lens moved 3.75M cache tokens while the 22-turn Read-only quality-engineer lens moved 472k for comparable finding yield. Turn count and tool mix are the levers; uncached input is trivial (15-27k) and output modest (25-51k) everywhere. CAPTURE DISCREPANCY, recorded per the provenance discipline: the harness notification figure (e.g. quality-engineer 71,732) matches no simple combination of the transcript usage fields — two capture sources, two numbers, definitions to be pinned before either enters a band. Signal candidates for the effort/optimization catalog (AI Engineer owned): api-turn count per dispatch; tool-mix ratio (search-shaped Bash vs whole-file Read); cache-read per turn (context growth); cache-write (context accumulated); output per finding. Bootstrap adapter: a ~30-line transcript parser, run per round — no conduct change required to measure, per the operator's observe-first ruling.

cf552651-b54d-46f7-bd5e-35bbdbc983a6.content: ROUND 1 FINAL COST ACTUALS (all five lenses complete; capture source: harness task telemetry — total tokens, runtime, tool-use count per agent; the vehicle exposes NO cache-class or input/output split, and none is fabricated): quality-engineer 71,732 tokens / 6m21s / 10 tool uses; ux 50,948 / 7m24s / 22; solution-owner 127,581 / 11m6s / 29; solution-architect 124,746 / 11m38s / 24; documentation-reviewer 105,111 / 12m47s / 33. DERIVED MAKEUP (measured file sizes, chars/4, labeled estimate — not observed): the governing contract is ~37k tokens read whole; the nine artifacts ~12k combined; schemas ~8k; one domain prompt ~1k. The correlation is the makeup story: the two lenses that read the whole contract (SO 127k, SA 125k) cost roughly double the two that read excerpts (UX 51k, QE 72k). The contract re-read is the price driver, per-lens, and the retrieval-shaped-artifacts clause exists precisely to license excerpt reads. f7d4a19d-8eeb-4979-852f-492e28744096.title: c1 minor collector: write-path hygiene and durability scope
f7d4a19d-8eeb-4979-852f-492e28744096.description: (1) SE+security convergent: the fixed dotfile temp name — failed fs::write leaves the partial temp behind (only the rename arm cleans up) and concurrent writers collide on the identical name; tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in + persist gives unique names and RAII cleanup (promote the existing dev-dependency). (2) SE: no fsync before rename — a crash can durably publish a truncated state.yaml; OPERATOR-SHAPED half: implement sync_all before rename, or narrow the module doc's claim to in-process failures for a git-tracked artifact (a scope ruling). (3) security: no byte bound on reads — serde_yaml_ng bounds amplification and nesting (probed: repetition and recursion limits fire) but a flat huge file is fully materialized pre-parse; a capped reader with a documented limit fails oversize fast. Owner: software-engineer. Validator: security.

9627f1ef-c162-408d-acfe-4766f0803a93.author: xqjG
9627f1ef-c162-408d-acfe-4766f0803a93.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21), item 2: NARROW THE CLAIM. The module doc states atomicity covers in-process failure orderings; crash durability is explicitly out of scope — the state artifact is boundary-committed and the read-failure discipline's restore-from-boundary recovery is the designed crash path. No fsync lands: an untestable-in-CI guarantee the decomposition never asserted stays unclaimed, consistent with the falsifiability doctrine. Items 1 and 3 keep their code-side dispositions (unique temp names via the promoted tempfile dependency; the capped reader).
